list.heading: Vibes
list.intro: Curated group activities & events — no swiping. Tap “I’m interested” and the host’s algorithm builds the room from the most compatible people, up to capacity. (Want 1:1? Find a Buddy.)
list.completeCheck: Complete your activity vibe check to unlock smart matching →
list.emptyPast: No past Vibes in the last 45 days yet.
list.emptySearch: No Vibes match your search. Try a different activity or city.
list.emptyNone: No Vibes yet. Be the first to create one.

detail.notFoundBody: It may have been cancelled or removed.
detail.cancelledBanner: This Vibe was cancelled by the host. The chat is now inactive.
detail.approxArea: Approximate area · exact location unlocks after confirmation
detail.reviewCta: ⭐ How was it? Review this Vibe
detail.matchingSubtitle: The algorithm ranks and invites — no host approval needed.
detail.differentCity: Heads up — this Vibe is in <hl>{city}</hl>, not your home city. You can still join if you’ll be there.
detail.suggestionsSubtitle: This one filled up — here’s what fits your vibe better.

create.subtitleRunAgain: Same details, fresh date — set a new start, deadline and spots, then publish.
create.subtitleCreate: A curated group room — attendees are matched by vibe, not first-come. No swiping.
create.successBody: Share it to invite people. They tap “I’m interested” and the algorithm builds the room from the most compatible.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What’s the plan, the vibe, who it’s for…
create.whatToBringPlaceholder: e.g. Bring a towel & $10 for the boards — we split the taco bill.
create.customActivityPlaceholder: Write your own: pottery, karaoke, book swap...
create.activityHelp: Pick one or more — tap to add, tap a chip to remove. Flockie pre-fills the likely vibe tags from your first pick, and you can swap them below.
create.activityLinkPlaceholder: Paste a GetYourGuide (or any) activity link
create.activityLinkHelp: Everyone who gets in receives this link, on the Vibe and in the chat.
create.customDurationHelp: How many hours the Vibe runs (1–24).
create.interestWindowHelp: Interest stays open until this time, then the algorithm ranks everyone and builds your list.
create.approxHelp: Everyone sees only this approximate location until they confirm.
create.fieldExactLocation: Exact venue or address (confirmed attendees only)
create.exactLocationPlaceholder: Venue name, street, or Google Maps address
create.exactLocationHelp: Check the pin is right. The host always sees it; attendees unlock it only after confirming.
create.locationMsgNoPin: Couldn’t find a clear pin. Try adding a street, area, or venue name.
create.locationMsgFound: Found a likely exact pin. Use it if the address looks right.
create.locationMsgFailed: Map lookup failed. You can still type the location manually.
create.locationMsgAdded: Exact address added to the location line.
create.algoFill: How much should the algorithm fill?
create.algoFillFull: The algorithm fills the whole room.
create.algoFillPartial: The algorithm fills {pct}% — the rest are yours to invite via your private link.
create.eventVibeTagsHelp: We pre-fill these from your activity so the algorithm always has a signal. Tap to swap.
create.diversityFloor: Diversity floor — reserves a few spots for outliers so the room isn’t an echo chamber.
create.pinnedComing: Host’s pinned picks (bypass the algorithm) coming next.
create.errFillRequired: Please fill in all required fields.
create.errLocationRequired: A location is required — it’s sent to attendees and pinned in the chat.
create.errPhotoRequired: Add at least one cover photo — upload one or generate it.
create.errTagRequired: Pick at least one event vibe tag — it powers the matching.
create.errDeadlineBeforeStart: Signup deadline must be before the start time.
create.errEndAfterStart: End time must be after the start time.
create.errAgeOrder: Minimum age can’t be greater than the maximum age.

interest.appealMessage: Tell us what happened. This is private to Flockie.
interest.popupConfirmedBody: You’re confirmed — the Vibing Chat is open.
interest.popupRunningBody: We’ll notify you the moment matching runs and invites go out.
interest.takeVibeForm: Take the 60-second Vibe form so the algorithm reads you right.

host.sendInvitesMessage: Invited people can no longer be rejected here.
host.removeMsgStarted: After the Vibe starts, only safety removals are available.
host.removeMsgPick: Pick a reason. This is private to Flockie.
host.noteRequired: Please add a short private note for that reason.

host.removalsCount: Normal removals: {used}/{limit}. Safety removals require a note and don’t count.
